title: ari-aml-runlog-todo
content:
2026-03-10 — Daily runlog / quick notes (personal)

Top-level goals for the day:
- stabilize int8 pipeline for redwood-7b-v1 shrink test
- run small eval suite (instruction-following + rerank) on quantized variants
- triage weird generation artifact from 2026-03-09 baseline run

TODO (quick):
- [ ] add dynamic range calibration step to q8 pipeline (follow up on Liam's note)
- [x] rerun baseline float32 small-batch (2026-03-09) -> saved as run_20260309_f32
- [ ] produce 1-page summary for SE sync (deadline 2026-03-12)
- [ ] try nf4 per-layer on attention weights only (low priority)

Recent experiment summaries:
- run_20260309_f32: 50 eval prompts, instruction-following, temp 0.0 (deterministic)
  - MRR@5: 0.614
  - accuracy (exact match style): 0.47
  - p50 latency (1 token): 42ms on g4dn-like instance
  - notes: occasional truncation at "--" marker in prompt, likely tokenizer edgecase

- run_20260310_q8_0: q8_0 w/ per-layer symmetric calibrate, bitsandbytes backend
  - MRR@5: 0.599 (drop vs f32)
  - accuracy: 0.44
  - p50 latency: 27ms (good)
  - mem usage: ~6.2GB per model shard
  - observation: hallucination rate up for arithmetic prompts, check softmax scaling

- run_20260310_q4_0: aggressive q4_0, cache disabled
  - MRR@5: 0.56
  - accuracy: 0.39
  - artifacts: repeated token insertion when prompt has nested lists; seems related to KV-cache alignment when quantized

Immediate hypotheses to test:
- hypothesis A: Softmax/temperature interplay is more brittle under q4 -> try ablation with explicit logit scaling + small temp (0.1)
- hypothesis B: Tokenization boundary around em-dash and double-dash causes KV cache key mismatch -> craft tests with controlled punctuation

Quick prompt set (for local runs, small deterministic suite):
1) Instruction: "Summarize the following paragraph in one short sentence:" + paragraph about battery tech (3-4 sentences)
2) Math: "What is 17 * 23? Show work." (expect exact)
3) Rerank: give 5 candidate answers, pick best short factual answer about the capital of a country
4) Code: "Given this Python function, what's the bug?" small snippet with off-by-one
5) Edge case: prompt with nested lists and em-dashes to reproduce truncation

Notes-to-self about quantization setup:
- backend: bitsandbytes (bnb) q8_0 and q4_0 variants; try nf4 (ggml style) as soon as cluster slot available
- calibration: used per-layer min/max on representative 2048-token slice from user-data-sample-12 (may be biased)
- always keep sample seeds logged (seed=20260310-ari-1)
- check per-head scale factors; if head-wise scales vary > 2x, consider per-head quantization or clip

Quick commands used (local):
- python infra/quantize.py --model redwood-7b-v1 --scheme q8_0 --calib sample2048.json --out out/q8_20260310
- python bench/eval_small.py --model out/q8_20260310 --prompts prompts/day_small.json --seed 20260310 --batch 2

Strange log snippet from 2026-03-09 baseline (keep here):
"[infer] token 42: emitting '\u2014' then sudden -cache-flush- - mismatch length 1 vs 0"
Interpretation: token is em-dash encoded as single codepoint but tokenizer sometimes yields two tokens in preproc path; need to inspect tokenization pipeline, maybe inside tokenizer.py we do .replace('\u2013','-') somewhere causing inconsistency.

Experiment plan (next 3 days):
Day 1: reproduce truncation with minimal prompt set; instrument tokenizer and KV cache key hashes
Day 2: iterate quantization calibration (per-layer clip, different representative samples), run ablations on softmax scaling
Day 3: prepare short bench + slides for SE sync (include cost/latency tradeoff table)

Bench notes / metrics to collect for sync slide:
- tokens/sec per GPU (with batching at batch=4) for f32, q8, q4
- p50/p95 latency (1 step and end-to-end for 128 token gen)
- MRR and accuracy on small suite
- memory footprint + expected reserved GPU count for 99th percentile traffic estimate

Misc reminders / links:
- check Liam's comment on GH PR 318 about "calib sample bias"
- compare to past baseline run run_20251115_q8 which had less hallucination (why?)
- drop-in test: try vendor q8 with fused softmax kernel (if available)

Random quick log (brain dump):
- feeling: 75% productive, need to escalate hardware slot for nf4 testing
- ping infra for ephemeral GPU 2h block tomorrow morning

End of scratchpad for 2026-03-10.
